map.作文字数统计：字符总数 = 全部字符（含标点与空格）；纯文字字数 = 中文字符数: Essay word counting: total characters = every character (punctuation and spaces included); plain word count = Chinese characters + English words (split on whitespace); punctuation = the sum of matched Chinese and English punctuation; paragraphs = the number of non-empty blocks separated by line breaks; average sentence length = total words ÷ number of sentence-ending marks, used to check an essay against its requirements and its layout.

map.春天来了，万物复苏。公园里的花开了，红的像火，粉的像霞，白的像雪。小草从土里探出:
Spring has arrived and everything comes back to life. The flowers in the park are in bloom, some red like fire, some pink like the rosy clouds, some white like snow. The young grass pokes its head out of the soil, tender and green.

The birds sing cheerfully on the branches and the butterflies flutter among the flowers. The children take off their thick coats and come to the playground to fly kites. All kinds of kites drift across the sky, eagles and swallows and butterflies, and it is all so lovely!

I love spring, I love its energy, I love its blaze of colour.
